video_goal: Demonstrate how to properly insert and validate a paper train ticket using a Trenitalia platform machine.
required_subjects_and_props: Person, Trenitalia paper ticket, green and white Trenitalia validation machine, train platform environment

outline_steps.visual_action: A person walks up to a green and white Trenitalia validation machine mounted on a metal pole at an outdoor train platform.
The person holds up a rectangular Trenitalia paper ticket, displaying the red and white logo and printed journey details to the camera.
The person's hands rotate the ticket 180 degrees to position the blank, narrow edge at the top, preparing it for insertion.
The camera pans down the curved front of the Trenitalia validation machine, stopping to center on the wide, horizontal insertion slot at the bottom.
The hand holding the ticket moves toward the machine, aligning the top edge of the paper perfectly parallel with the horizontal slot.
The edge of the paper ticket slides into the far-left side of the validation machine's slot.
The hand pushes the ticket deep into the slot, pressing it firmly against the back wall of the machine until it stops moving.
The paper ticket shifts slightly downward as the internal stamping mechanism physically clamps onto the edge of the paper.
A small circular LED indicator light on the front of the machine flashes green, signaling the stamping process is complete.
The hand pinches the bottom of the ticket and pulls it smoothly and horizontally out of the machine's slot.
The camera focuses tightly on the edge of the ticket, revealing a freshly printed black ink timestamp and station code along the margin.
The person lowers the validated ticket, tucks it into a wallet, and turns their body toward the train tracks.
